background_story: Meredith's life was forever changed when her mother revealed a shocking family secret. Born in the 1950s, Meredith's mother had been prescribed diethylstilbestrol (DES) during her pregnancy, a synthetic estrogen that was later discovered to have devastating health consequences. As a result, Meredith was exposed to DES in utero, which led to a range of health issues throughout her life. Despite the challenges she faced, Meredith became an advocate for DES awareness, working tirelessly to support others who had been affected by the drug. Her determination and resilience inspired countless individuals, and she eventually became a leading voice in the fight for justice and compensation for DES victims. Meredith's story is a testament to the enduring power of the human spirit in the face of adversity.

For all humans, if they either have a family member with an illness or have an inherited trait, then they have a medical vulnerability.

Anyone who has an inherited trait or a relative with a medical condition has a family history.
If Meredith experiences adversity, then she will require medical attention and have a genetic disorder.
Anyone who has a family history and a genetic disorder will face health challenges.
For all humans, if they were exposed to DES, then they face health challenges.
